description:
***NEW TO THE MARKET***
3 Bed Bungalow, Enaghan, Aughnacliffe, Co. Longford, N39 W328

Located c. 4.5km from Arva just off the Arva to Aughnacliffe Road this 3 bed bungalow is situated on a large elevated site overlooking Lough Gowna lake.  The property comprises of an entrance hall, kitchen dining living area, sitting room, family bathroom, utility and 3 bedrooms.  Outside there is a large garage / shed, a greenhouse and a very spacious garden.

The property is located less than 30 minutes from both Cavan Town and Longford Town and is within driving distance of all amenities Arva and Aughnacliffe have to offer.

Thanks to its extremely convenient location this property would suit a wide variety of potential customers.

VIEWING HIGHLY RECOMMENDED AND STRICTLY BY APPOINTMENT WITH AUCTIONEER ONLY.
